description: This file defines the `RecordedConnectionIssue` struct which manages recording, resolving, and delaying retries for connection issues within the Orleans framework. It provides utility methods for handling connection issue lifecycle events and notifies listeners accordingly.

classes.name: RecordedConnectionIssue
classes.description: A utility struct for recording and managing connection issues, including notification to listeners and delay before retries.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a new connection issue, updates timing and failure count, and notifies listener.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the current recorded issue, notifies listener, and clears it.

methods.name: DelayBeforeRetry
methods.description: Delays asynchronously for the configured retry delay if an issue is recorded.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the issue, or empty if none.
